findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 3, Harm 3
Raise: Not done. `board()` builds a new headline from selected counts instead of `team.sentence`, omits the labelled totals, and never reads `team.in_progress`; an in-progress item without a running worker goes into WAITING OR NOT STARTED. It also omits the board's go-live wording when the status is `done` or `not enough history`. The page draws those first-screen facts from `team` (`board_visuals.py:109-203,332`), so the Board tab and `/forge` still do not open with the same facts.

Raise: Not done. `team.needs_you` is sorted oldest first (`board_facts.py:224`), but the pane looks up its entries while walking `board.items`, so its Needs you rows follow item order instead. With two people waiting on different items, the pane can put the newer wait first and show different first five rows from the board.
